integrity: The final claim separates the new equality characterization from the published universal bound and from the independently published James-constant value; no numerical experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The equivalence uses finite-dimensional compact attainment; in infinite dimension it is asserted only when an extremizer exists.
No classification of all extremizers is claimed.
